summary: Expand evidence configuration readers to prefer .fractal/ and read .st/ only when the new file is absent at the same accepted revision or checkout root.

replay.detail: Signed history is unchanged; historical replay uses tools from its historical accepted base.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint-rule change. Evidence protections and review-risk rules cover both configuration directories without changing permissions.

compatibility.detail: arn:lmig:smalltalk:2026-10-27-dot-fractal-config: all 13 configuration files remain in .st/. New files win when both layouts exist; malformed or unreadable new files and Git failures never downgrade to old trust data. Both layouts enter script-test projections, while required definition paths still name existing .st/.

manual.detail: No configuration move or key rotation in this expand step. Accepted-base rollout and external retirement receipts gate the later move.

recovery.detail: Before the directory move, revert the bridge and projection/protection changes together while .st/ remains the sole layout.
